s:
Arrange the following Reddi rulers in chronological order.

A. Kumaragiri Reddi

B. Anavema Reddi

C. Anavota Reddi

D. Pedakomati Vema Reddi
x:
The Reddi Kingdom was founded by Prolaya Vema Reddi after the decline of the Kakatiyas. The rulers mentioned in this question succeeded one another in the following order: Anavota Reddi succeeded Prolaya Vema Reddi and consolidated the newly established kingdom. He was followed by Anavema Reddi, who further strengthened the administration and expanded the kingdom. After him came Kumaragiri Reddi, who was an able administrator and a great patron of literature, music and dance. His court became an important centre of Telugu culture. Finally, Pedakomati Vema Reddi ascended the throne. He was both a scholar and a capable ruler and continued the literary traditions established by his predecessors. Therefore, the correct chronological order is: Anavota Reddi → Anavema Reddi → Kumaragiri Reddi → Pedakomati Vema Reddi Hence, the correct answer is Option (4).
Exam Note:
• Founder – Prolaya Vema Reddi
• Capital – Addanki (later Kondavidu)
• Greatest literary patron – Kumaragiri Reddi
